Coverage_Description: Waives premiums on the attached basic policy if the insured is totally disabled for at least 180 consecutive days due to accident or illness; benefit applies up to age 61
customer requirement: must be added to a basic plan at policy application
price structure: non-guaranteed premium rates; insurer may review and adjust by risk class at each policy anniversary
additional informations: Major exclusions include pre-existing conditions, war/riot, alcohol or drugs (without medical instruction), suicide/self-harm, criminal acts; terminates at earliest death, 1-month premium default, base plan termination, or end of coverage term
